_comment: Phase N-3 — Cursor subagents. The Cursor SDK consumes this file to expose declarative subagents alongside MCP tools. Each entry maps to a script in scripts/subagent_*.mjs that returns structured JSON. They are also callable via the sima-atlas MCP server (same names, prefixed `subagent_`).

schema-syncer.description: Walks all atlas blocks, runs every consistency validator (rules / tech_stack / dependency contracts / acceptance assertions / cursor hooks / agent parity / parity matrix), classifies blocks as ok / drift / broken, and emits a structured drift report with the offending reason per block.
schema-syncer.use_when: Before promoting a block to done; before sending context-pack to a coding agent; on every nightly.

verifier.description: For one block (or --all): runs scripts/verify_block_acceptance.mjs (deterministic acceptance) AND scripts/atlas_synthesis_api.mjs::validateBlock (LLM-judge: mission vs reality + rules + tech_stack + acceptance + KPI conditions). Returns combined verdict aligned/drift/broken with violations + matches.
verifier.use_when: After every coding-agent run on a block; before allowing wip → done transition.

wiki-builder.description: Regenerates atlas/WIKI.md, atlas/wiki.html (with Mermaid graph), atlas/roadmap.md, ТЗ/auto_tz.md from canonical graph + per-block files. Idempotent — safe to call after any block edit.
wiki-builder.use_when: After a block's mission/kpi/acceptance changed; on every nightly; before exporting docs to the operator.
